agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Toor called the regular March 7, 2000 meeting of the Boulder City Council to order at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.title: CITIZEN PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES OF FEBRUARY 15, 2000.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION ACCEPTING THE FEBRUARY 4 & 5, 2000 CITY COUNCIL RETREAT SUMMARY.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF EMERGENCY ORDINANCE NO. 7041 ADOPTING SUPPLEMENT NO. 63 WHICH CODIFIES PREVIOUSLY ADOPTED ORDINANCE NOS. 6083, 6099, 7001, 7002, 7003, 7004, 7008, 7010, 7011, 7012, 7018, 7021, 7023, AND 7024, AS AN AMENDMENT TO THE BOULDER REVISED CODE 1981, AND SETTING FORTH DETAILS IN RELATION THERETO.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION CONCERNING THE PROPOSED CITY OF BOULDER, COLORADO OPEN SPACE ACQUISITION BONDS, SERIES 2000, IN A PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF $20,095,000; AUTHORIZING THE OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE WITH RESPECT TO SAID SERIES 2000 BONDS; PRESCRIBING CERTAIN DETAILS CONCERNING SAID PROPOSED SALE AND SAID SERIES 2000 BONDS; APPROVING THE FORM OF A PRELIMINARY OFFICIAL STATEMENT; AND PROVIDING THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF THIS RESOLUTION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Update regarding the process to date and next steps was presented by Ms. Molly Winter, Director of Downtown, University Hill, and Parking Services.

agenda_items.title: UPDATE ON STATUS OF THE DOWNTOWN MALL MASTER PLAN
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Update regarding the process to date and next steps was presented by Ms. Molly Winter, Director of Downtown, University Hill, and Parking Services.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY: - none

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL

agenda_items.title: POTENTIAL CALL-UPS

SITE REVIEW AND USE REVIEW FOR A 200 ROOM, 55 FOOT TALL HOTEL, A 55 FOOT TALL CIVIC USE BUILDING, AND A 656 SPACE UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE AT 9TH STREET AND CANYON BOULEVARD. LAST OPPORTUNITY FOR CALL-UP: 3/7/00. WIP DATE:2/23/00 . APPROVED BY THE PLANNING BOARD (6-1; T. KRUEGER OPPOSED.)
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion failed: 2-4, Havlick and Poinsatte in favor, Eldridge recused, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: DOWNTOWN MALL MASTER PLAN CONCEPTUAL DESIGN. LAST OPPORTUNITY FOR CALL-UP” 3-7-00. WIP DATE: 2-10-00. UNANIMOUS APPROVAL BY DMC.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: LEGISLATIVE ISSUES
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC COMMENT
FINAL DECISIONS

INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE CURRENT FOOD SERVICE LICENSE REQUIREMENT BY ADDING A NEW CHAPTER 12 "FOOD SERVICE ESTABLISHMENT EXCISE TAX" TO TITLE 3 "REVENUE AND TAXATION," AND AMENDING SECTION 4-20-9 "FOOD SERVICE AND VENDING MACHINE OPERATOR LICENSE FEES" AND AMENDING CHAPTER 4-9 "FOOD SERVICE ESTABLISHMENT TAX LICENSE AND FOOD VENDING MACHINE TAX LICENSE" OF THE BOULDER REVISED CODE 1981.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 2 "BEVERAGES LICENSE" OF TITLE 4 "LICENSES AND PERMITS" OF THE BOULDER REVISED CODE 1981.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE MAJOR STREET SETBACK MAP, APPENDIX C-1, OF THE LAND USE REGULATIONS, REMOVING THE MAJOR STREET DESIGNATION FOR BROADWAY, CANYON BOULEVARD, FOLSOM, PEARL AND WALNUT WITHIN THE AREAS BOUNDED BY IRIS, BASELINE, FOLSOM AVENUE, AND THE WEST CITY LIMITS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE TO AUTHORIZE THE CITY MANAGER TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT FOR THE RESERVATION OF RESIDENTIAL GROWTH MANAGEMENT ALLOCATIONS FOR THE DAKOTA RIDGE VILLAGE SUBDIVISION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel & Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Lopez, to approve Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-D.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to call-up the Site Review and Use Review for a 200 room, 55 foot tall hotel, a 55 foot tall civic use building, and a 656 space underground parking garage at 9th Street and Canyon Boulevard.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed: 2-4, Havlick and Poinsatte in favor, Eldridge recused, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Councilmember Havlick to support H.B. 1223, with the amendments proposed by Representative Plant while acknowledging the concerns outlined by the City Attorney and directing him to work toward further amendments which would clarify the language of the bill.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick, to introduce and publish by title only Ordinance No. 7042 amending the current food service license requirement by adding a new chapter 12 "Food Service Establishment Excise Tax" to Title 3 "Revenue and Taxation," and amending Section 4-20-9 "Food Service and Vending Machine Operator License Fees" and amending Chapter 4-9 "Food Service Establishment Tax License and Food Vending Machine Tax License" of the Boulder Revised Code 1981.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Mock, to introduce and publish by title only Ordinance No. 7043 amending Chapter 2 "Beverages License" of Title 4 "Licenses and Permits" of the Boulder Revised Code 1981.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Havlick, to introduce and publish by title only Ordinance No. 7044 amend the Major Street Setback Map, Appendix C-1, of the Land Use Regulations, removing the Major Street designation for Broadway, Canyon Boulevard, Folsom, Pearl and Walnut within the areas bounded by Iris, Baseline, Folsom Avenue, and the west City limits.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson, to introduce and publish by title only Ordinance No. 7045 authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement for the reservation of Residential Growth Management Allocations for the Dakota Ridge Village Subdivision.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 7-0, Morzel & Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:18 p.m.

open_comment_speakers.name: John Seaborn
open_comment_speakers.topic: As president of the Boulder Soaring Society, urged Council to remove the Boulder Airport site from the list of city properties identified for review for possible alternative uses.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lisa Mainero
open_comment_speakers.topic: support for the Boulder Airport - listed several community benefits of the local airport.

open_comment_speakers.name: David Silberman
open_comment_speakers.topic: North Boulder Power line, noted that there seemed to be large discrepancies in cost estimates for the undergrounding project.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ben Lattora
open_comment_speakers.topic: cost of golf fee at Flatirons course for out of city senior resident. Noted that it is more expensive than four other courses in the Boulder area.

open_comment_speakers.name: Mary Boisseau
open_comment_speakers.topic: negative impacts of airport noise on local residents.

open_comment_speakers.name: Robert Sharpe
open_comment_speakers.topic: numerous local school issues. Also asked if there is consideration for moving the site for the Palo Park school further out. If so, he would be opposed.

open_comment_speakers.name: David Wagner
open_comment_speakers.topic: Traffic Mitigation, appalled by the lack of progress to date towards this critical goal.

open_comment_speakers.name: Frank Ohrtman
open_comment_speakers.topic: C.A.T.V. temporary contract. Encouraged allowing the contract to lapse thus allowing CATV to become a private enterprise.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ricky Weiser
open_comment_speakers.topic: 1) supported item 3-d, 2) item 6-a, concerned about view , 3) opposed to traffic mitigation devices, and 4) still concerned about 18 wheelers on Pearl Parkway.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lisah Brown
open_comment_speakers.topic: traffic circles on 14 th and Pine. As resident, opposed to being denied vote on these structures.

open_comment_speakers.name: Warren Hultquist
open_comment_speakers.topic: NTMP memo to Council on March 2 nd , noted that process was unfair in that residents on Pine and Balsam were not allowed to vote on devices.

open_comment_speakers.name: Evan Ravitz
open_comment_speakers.topic: undo influence from Transportation Division on Boulder residents.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rob Smoke
open_comment_speakers.topic: J&B billboard truck atrocity, noting that young people are being targeted by this subversive advertising.

open_comment_speakers.name: Shaun Dalrymple
open_comment_speakers.topic: Chair of C.A.T.V. Provided an update regarding the current operations of Channel 54.

open_comment_speakers.name: Richard Hayward
open_comment_speakers.topic: stated opposition to the traffic circles on 14 th and Pine.

open_comment_speakers.name: Richard Peddie
open_comment_speakers.topic: current director and soon to be chair of C.A.T.V. informed Council that in his opinion the current Board of Directors is more able than previous boards to succeed in providing quality service.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lynn Segal
open_comment_speakers.topic: Call-up of 9 th and Canyon, appalled that there was no cost benefit analysis required for this project.
